## Change and rationale

State the need this addresses and where the canonical explanation lives.

## Review

Identify affected skills, criterion IDs, guides, and links. Justify policy changes separately;
distinguish recommendations from implemented controls.

## Validation

List commands, results, and limitations. For skill, criteria, or evaluation case changes, include
the evaluation results. For validator changes, identify a case that demonstrates the behavior. For
recommendation changes, cite the source reviewed and the date.
